title: Connected TV and Over-The-Top Advertising Solutions in Tampa - Advertise In Tampa

facts.fact: Beasley Media Group's CTV page cites an average nonskippable CTV ad completion rate of 98%, attributed to an eMarketer article.
facts.quote: On average, nonskippable CTV ads have a **[98% ad completion rate](https://www.emarketer.com/content/why-marketers-should-understand-differences-between-ctv-ott)**.

facts.fact: Beasley's page cites an eMarketer projection that CTV ad spending is expected to surpass traditional TV ad spending by 2028.
facts.quote: CTV ad spending is expected to **[surpass traditional TV ad spending by 2028](https://www.emarketer.com/content/one-of-largest-sources-of-new-video-ad-inventory-spending-ctv)**.

facts.fact: Beasley's page cites a Proximic 2025 report stating that 89% of CTV ads use verified IDs for attribution.
facts.quote: **[89% of CTV ads use verified IDs](https://www.proximic.com/Insights/Presentations-and-Whitepapers/2025/2025-State-of-Programmatic-Report)** for attribution to improve user targeting.

facts.fact: Beasley Media Group states it offers precise audience targeting to a growing audience of 1,499,200 Tampa Bay consumers.
facts.quote: Tap into our growing audience of 1,499,200 Tampa Bay consumers eager to learn about your business.

facts.fact: Beasley Media Group says it has over 60 years of experience connecting businesses to engaged audiences.
facts.quote: We're a content and marketing powerhouse with over 60 years of experience connecting businesses to engaged audiences.

facts.fact: Beasley's page lists preroll, midroll and postroll as available video ad format options.
facts.quote: choosing from a range of ad format options, including preroll, midroll and postroll

facts.fact: Beasley's page states that streaming giants such as Amazon and Apple each set their own rules for resolution, frame rate, bitrate and format.
facts.quote: every streaming giant has their own set of rules regarding resolution, frame rate, bitrate and format.

facts.fact: Advertise In Tampa, operated by Beasley Media Group, states it has been connecting businesses with their ideal customers since 1961.
facts.quote: Connecting businesses with their ideal customers since 1961.

facts.fact: The site states that California consumers have the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of their personal information at any time.
facts.quote: As a California consumer, you have the right to opt-out from the sale or sharing of your personal information at any time across business platform, services, businesses and devices.

facts.fact: The site states that Virginia, Utah, Colorado and Connecticut consumers have the right to opt out of the sale of personal data and of its processing for targeted advertising.
facts.quote: As a Virginia, Utah, Colorado and Connecticut consumer, you have the right to opt-out from the sale of your personal data and the processing of your personal data for targeted advertising.
